mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic properties and CNS depressant effects; meclizine may impair rilpivirine absorption due to gastric pH alterations and additive CNS depression increases sedation risk.
action: Monitor for increased sedation and CNS effects; ensure adequate spacing of administration and counsel on avoiding concurrent CNS depressants; meclizine's anticholinergic effects may reduce rilpivirine bioavailability.
